content: MedlinePlus, along with the MedlinePlus Medical Encyclopedia, is a comprehensive online resource that provides health information sourced from the United States National Library of Medicine, the largest medical library in the world, in collaboration with the National Institutes of Health. The website includes an online medical dictionary, a drug and herbal index, and a news service that delivers updates on medical news reports. It is specifically designed for use by both healthcare providers and patients, offering reliable, up-to-date, and authoritative medical information. MedlinePlus is updated daily to ensure the accuracy and relevance of its content. The platform also features the Health Illustrated Encyclopedia, a medical dictionary provided by Merriam-Webster, and health information available in Spanish. It offers extensive details on both prescription and non-prescription drugs, as well as health-related information from various media sources. Additionally, the site provides links to local health resources through the Go Local projects, access to thousands of clinical trials, and pre-formulated searches of the MEDLINE/PubMed database for recent research articles on selected health topics. Importantly, MedlinePlus does not host advertisements and does not endorse any companies or products. The platform is maintained by the U.S. National Library of Medicine, located at 8600 Rockville Pike, Bethesda, MD, in conjunction with the National Institutes of Health.
